original_test_intent: Inject an uncorrectable TXWAFL fault on the intended CCD path, confirm the approved containment/reset and a fresh CCD-attributed error record, then validate the affected compute die, NUMA topology and fabric path recover.
original_method: Map socket, CCD, TXWAFL link and direction; prove link0/location1/errortype1 semantics; preserve raw settings and log baselines; inject once under OOB capture; decode a fresh CCD/TXWAFL MCA/CPER/BERT source; verify CCD cores, NUMA node, memory access and inter-die traffic; restore all threshold, BIOS and HDT state.
manual_activity: The FAE identifies the exact CCD/TXWAFL path, resolves duplicated correctable acceptance text, approves containment, performs the single fault under OOB observation and restores compute/fabric state.
required_inputs: Socket/CCD/CCX/core/NUMA-to-TXWAFL topology and link0/location1 coverage map
Vendor proof of --twixwafl errortype1 and location1 semantics
Authoritative replacement or approval for duplicated correctable acceptance language
FF5/FFE threshold encoding, CCD/TXWAFL relevance and raw restore values
CCD-specific fresh MCA/CPER/BERT/SEL fields and expected containment/reset
Supported OS, timeout, core/NUMA/memory/fabric recovery limits, aborts and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT with independent OOB access and quiesced compute/memory workloads
Preserve raw baselines before any log clear or sticky-state handling
Run one mapped CCD injection once; never extrapolate location1 or link0 across platforms
Abort on wrong die/source, unexpected severity/reset, boot loop, missing cores/NUMA node, MCA growth, memory error or absent fresh record
No automatic retry/reset; restore and diff all RAS/HDT settings
agent_execution_scope: Validate CCD topology, tuple/severity, threshold, fresh evidence and compute recovery plan
Collect read-only enumeration, raw settings, OOB timeline, MCA/CPER/BERT/SEL, CPU/core/NUMA/memory and fabric-health evidence
Do not select CCD/link, modify BIOS/HDT, inject, reset, recover, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve severity text and approve CCD tuple map
Approve containment and CCD-specific durable oracle

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a topology-bound CCD TXWAFL UCE with fresh die-specific evidence and post-event compute/NUMA validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact CCD coverage, resolves duplicated acceptance conflict, defines source fields, time limits, compute recovery and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A tool result and generic dmesg entry cannot prove which CCD was targeted or that its cores and memory paths remain usable.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The fault may remove cores or a NUMA node, generate further MCA errors, reset the platform or destabilize inter-die traffic.

project_override_considerations: For platforms with multiple CCDs, a single location1/link0 tuple is not automatically representative; document required per-CCD applicability and preserve the original one-tuple source limitation as a coverage decision.
expected_evidence: Socket-to-CCD/core/NUMA/TXWAFL topology and raw link enumeration
Approved tuple/severity mapping and raw RAS/HDT baseline
Exact injection plus OOB containment/reset/boot timeline
All expected cores and NUMA nodes online, clean MCA delta, bounded memory/compute and fabric health

review_improvement: Establishes die-level attribution and compute recovery for the CCD variant while retaining both conflicting source acceptance copies for engineering resolution.
independent_technical_reasoning: A TXWAFL fault at a CCD is materially different from the adjacent IOD case: the failure may leave the OS booted while cores, a NUMA node or memory paths are degraded. The location bit and numeric link are vendor encodings, not a topology proof. Therefore acceptance needs a CCD-specific durable source record and post-event CPU/NUMA validation, after the duplicated correctable wording is resolved.
